QueryScientificRecordsFile.name: QueryScientificRecordsFile
QueryScientificRecordsFile.description: Filter, project and stably order a public JSON record file with explicit predicates and a typed string/integer identity field. Preserve source provenance and write complete output plus a bounded preview.
QueryScientificRecordsFile.call_signature: QueryScientificRecordsFile(records_file: str, id_field: str, predicates: list | None=None, fields: list | None=None, order_by: list | None=None, limit: int | None=None, preview_limit: int=20) -> dict

parameters.name: records_file
parameters.description: Uploaded or current-task artifact JSON file. Accepts a record list, or an object with a data list, containing 0–60,000 rows and at most 25 MiB. Private files and shared artifact directories are not readable.

parameters.name: id_field
parameters.description: Literal source identity key; every source ID must be a unique nonempty string or integer, with no implicit type conversion.

parameters.name: predicates
parameters.description: Null or up to 32 AND conditions. Each has field and op; binary operators require value and unary operators omit it. Missing predicate fields raise except for exists/missing. Null numeric comparisons return false. Validation precedes filtering, so condition order cannot hide malformed data.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Null keeps all fields. Otherwise provide up to 256 distinct top-level field names. The identity field is always retained. Missing requested fields in selected rows raise; explicit null values remain null.

parameters.name: order_by
parameters.description: Null or up to 8 distinct sort keys. Each key has field, optional direction (ascending/descending), and optional nulls (first/last). Missing fields or mixed non-null scalar families raise. Equal keys retain source order.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Null retains all matches. An integer from 0 to 60,000 limits rows after filtering and sorting. Full matching count and artifact output count are reported separately.

parameters.name: preview_limit
parameters.description: Return 0–100 complete preview rows within a 20,000-character budget. This does not change the full artifact. If a row exceeds the preview budget, omit it and report truncation; never return malformed partial JSON.

FitParametricCurve.output_description:
Fit one declared fixed curve family using bounded local least squares.

Families/formula/parameter order are public REGISTRY. There are2 or3 fitted
parameters, at most1000 observations, and observations must exceed parameter
count. Duplicate x observations are allowed; at least2 distinct x are needed.
Optional sigma are positive observation standard deviations, not weights;
residuals are divided by sigma. No weights are estimated. Absolute_sigma
affects approximate covariance scaling only. Bounds may narrow but never
widen family domains; per-entry null means the family's default bound.
Linear, soft_l1 or huber loss uses fixed f_scale1 in sigma-scaled units.
Return local optimizer diagnostics even when not converged; success only
means numeric termination, never global optimum or scientific applicability.
Approximate local covariance is supplied only for converged, full-column-rank,
interior linear-loss fits with residual df>0. It assumes independent errors,
a locally adequate model and supplied sigma conventions. Active bounds,
robust losses, nonconvergence or deficient rank return null covariance/SE.
No confidence interval, extrapolation validity or model-selection claim.

model.description: Selected family,exact formula,ordered fitted parameter names/values and observed x range; no task acceptance decision.

sample_count.description: Number of observed x/y pairs,duplicates retained.

residual_degrees_of_freedom.description: n minus parameter count,strictly positive; nuisance fitting is not ignored.

predictions.description: Model response values aligned with input x,original response units.

residuals.description: Prediction minus observed y in original input row order,response units.

residual_convention.description: Exact residual sign and unit convention.

rmse.description: sqrt(unweighted RSS/n),original response units; not residual standard error sqrt(RSS/df).

optimizer.description: SciPy local termination code/message,convergence flag,evaluation count,optimality,active-bound signs and loss; numeric convergence does not prove global optimum or scientific adequacy.

jacobian_rank.description: Numerical column rank of optimizer residual Jacobian,using machine-epsilon*max(shape)*largest singular-value cutoff. For robustloss Jacobian is the SciPy loss-modified approximation.

jacobian_singular_values.description: Descending singular values of local residual Jacobian; scale/unit dependent.

jacobian_condition_number.description: Largest/smallest singular-value ratio for full-column-rank Jacobian; null if deficient. Numeric conditioning is distinct from scientific identifiability.

parameter_covariance.description: Approximate k×k local covariance under explicit independent-error/linear-loss/interior/rank conditions; otherwise null. Units follow parameter products.

parameter_standard_errors.description: Square roots of local covariance diagonal,ordered parameter units; null when covariance unavailable. No confidence interval coverage claim.

covariance_status.description: Explicit reason local covariance is available or omitted; robustloss/bounds/nonconvergence/rankdeficiency are not silently treated as valid Wald inference.

sigma_mode.description: unit_relative when omitted,relative when supplied with residual-variance scaling,absolute when explicitly true.

scope.description: Scientific limits of local curve fitting/evaluation.

ElementwiseNumericOperations.output_description:
Apply one declared arithmetic operation to a numeric vector or matrix.

Args:
    operation: add/subtract/multiply/divide use values as the left operand.
        sqrt/log/exp/reciprocal/abs are unary. log is the natural logarithm.
    values: A nonempty 1D vector or nonempty rectangular 2D matrix, with at
        most 10000 total finite real entries in scientific row/column order.
        Ragged, mixed vector/matrix, empty rows and deeper nesting fail.
        Booleans/null/strings are rejected. Arithmetic is ordinary float64,
        not arbitrary-precision integer or symbolic arithmetic.
    other: For binary operations, either one finite numeric scalar broadcast
        to every row, or a finite vector of EXACTLY the same length. A
        one-element list is not broadcast. For a 2D matrix, other may be
        a scalar or an exactly matching rectangular 2D matrix; 1D vectors,
        single-row/column broadcasting and all implicit axis expansion fail. Unary operations require null.

Returns:
    dict with operation, values (same ordered shape, all finite floats),
    length (outer length), shape, element_count, operand_mode
    (unary/scalar_broadcast/aligned_vector/aligned_matrix), and scope.
    No file, network, code generation, expression evaluation, model fitting
    or unit inference occurs. Callers must establish compatible quantities,
    record alignment and meaningful transformations from scientific context.

Raises:
    ValueError: Invalid length/type/operation, zero division, negative square
        root, nonpositive logarithm, overflow/nonfinite result, or a nonzero
        multiply/divide/exp result that underflows to zero. Failing element
        indices are zero-based row-major indices.
        Entire calls fail; invalid rows are not dropped, clipped or imputed.

parameters.name: objective
parameters.description: Ordered1..500 finite real coefficients c of the REQUESTED objective c dot x. Internally divide by max(abs(c)) or1 for an all-zero objective. Nonzero normalized coefficients require abs>=1e-8; unsupported dynamic ranges fail with a rescaling hint. Boolean/string/null/nonfinite cells fail. Caller owns scientific variable definitions, units and order.

parameters.name: bounds
parameters.description: Exactly one explicit[lower,upper]pair per variable; finite endpoints have abs<=1e12. null means an unbounded endpoint, never zero. No implicit nonnegativity or broadcasting; fixed variables are allowed but lower cannot exceed upper.

parameters.name: inequality_matrix

Apply one declared arithmetic operation to a numeric vector or matrix.

Args:
    operation: add/subtract/multiply/divide use values as the left operand.
        sqrt/log/exp/reciprocal/abs are unary. log is the natural logarithm.
    values: A nonempty 1D vector or nonempty rectangular 2D matrix, with at
        most 10000 total finite real entries in scientific row/column order.
        Ragged, mixed vector/matrix, empty rows and deeper nesting fail.
        Booleans/null/strings are rejected. Arithmetic is ordinary float64,
        not arbitrary-precision integer or symbolic arithmetic.
    other: For binary operations, either one finite numeric scalar broadcast
        to every row, or a finite vector of EXACTLY the same length. A
        one-element list is not broadcast. For a 2D matrix, other may be
        a scalar or an exactly matching rectangular 2D matrix; 1D vectors,
        single-row/column broadcasting and all implicit axis expansion fail. Unary operations require null.

        indices are zero-based row-major indices.
        Entire calls fail; invalid rows are not dropped, clipped or imputed.

document.observation_model: Controlled exact label-count probabilities for the two carbon positions of neutral ethanol. Listed13C substitutions are exact isotope labels in the molecular graphs. document.analysis_policy: First remove the NMR datum and derive the sharp possible site1 enrichment interval from only the complete mass-count histogram and nonnegative joint fractions. Then restore the independent site1 enrichment and reconstruct all four joint state fractions. Covariance of site indicators is P(both)-P(site1)*P(site2).

document.model: Ideal gas reaction2M<=>Dunder one fixed temperature. Initially one mole Mis present and no D,at1bar in volume V0=n0*RT/P_initial. Both cases reach the same-temperature chemical equilibrium with Kp=(p_D/p_standard)/(p_M/p_standard)^2=1. Case1uses a quasistatic frictionless piston held at1bar;case2holds V0fixed. Only PVwork exists. Dimerization extent xiin moles obeys n_M=1-2xi,n_D=xiand0<=xi<=1/2. Isothermal internal-energy change is xi*DeltaU_reaction. Work BYthe gas is integral P_external*dVand heat INTOgas satisfies DeltaU=Q-W_by. The equilibrium constant is dimensionless and its standard pressure must be retained.
document.target: For each mechanical case in order,return dimerization extent,total final gas moles,final pressure,Vfinal/V0,work by the gas in kJ,and heat into the gas in kJ. Report whether the mechanical boundary leaves equilibrium extent unchanged.

arguments.code:
import math
n0 = 1.0
P0 = 1.0
pstd = 1.0
Kp = 1.0
RT = 2.5
dU_rxn = -10.0
a1 = 4.0*Kp*P0 + pstd
b1 = -(4.0*Kp*P0*n0 + pstd*n0)
c1 = Kp*P0*n0*n0
disc1 = b1*b1 - 4.0*a1*c1
sq1 = math.sqrt(disc1)
cands1 = [(-b1 - sq1)/(2.0*a1), (-b1 + sq1)/(2.0*a1)]
phys1 = [r for r in cands1 if r >= -1e-12 and r <= 0.5 + 1e-12 and n0 - 2.0*r >= -1e-12]
a2 = 4.0*Kp*P0
b2 = -(4.0*Kp*P0*n0 + pstd*pstd*n0)
c2 = Kp*P0*n0*n0
disc2 = b2*b2 - 4.0*a2*c2
sq2 = math.sqrt(disc2)
cands2 = [(-b2 - sq2)/(2.0*a2), (-b2 + sq2)/(2.0*a2)]
phys2 = [r for r in cands2 if r >= -1e-12 and r <= 0.5 + 1e-12 and n0 - 2.0*r >= -1e-12]
print('case1_candidate_roots', cands1)
print('case1_physical_root_count', len(phys1))
print('case2_candidate_roots', cands2)
print('case2_physical_root_count', len(phys2))
xi1 = max(0.0, min(0.5, phys1[0]))
xi2 = max(0.0, min(0.5, phys2[0]))
nM1 = n0 - 2.0*xi1
nD1 = xi1
nt1 = nM1 + nD1
nM2 = n0 - 2.0*xi2
nD2 = xi2
nt2 = nM2 + nD2
V0 = n0*RT/(P0*100.0)
P1 = P0
Vf1 = nt1*RT/(P1*100.0)
W1 = P1*100.0*(Vf1 - V0)
vr1 = Vf1/V0
Vf2 = V0
P2 = nt2*RT/(V0*100.0)
W2 = 0.0
vr2 = Vf2/V0
Q1 = xi1*dU_rxn + W1
Q2 = xi2*dU_rxn + W2
yD1 = nD1/nt1
yM1 = nM1/nt1
Kp1 = yD1*pstd/(pow(yM1, 2)*P1)
yD2 = nD2/nt2
yM2 = nM2/nt2
Kp2 = yD2*pstd/(pow(yM2, 2)*P2)
same = abs(xi1 - xi2) <= 1e-12
print('Kp_recheck_case1', Kp1)
print('Kp_recheck_case2', Kp2)
print('monomer_nonnegative_case1', nM1 >= 0.0)
print('monomer_nonnegative_case2', nM2 >= 0.0)
print('extent_leq_half_case1', xi1 <= 0.5)
print('extent_leq_half_case2', xi2 <= 0.5)
print('equilibrium_dimerization_extents_mol_by_case: [' + str(xi1) + ', ' + str(xi2) + ']')
print('final_total_gas_moles_by_case: [' + str(nt1) + ', ' + str(nt2) + ']')
print('final_pressures_bar_by_case: [' + str(P1) + ', ' + str(P2) + ']')
print('final_volume_over_initial_volume_by_case: [' + str(vr1) + ', ' + str(vr2) + ']')
print('work_by_gas_kJ_by_case: [' + str(W1) + ', ' + str(W2) + ']')
print('heat_into_gas_kJ_by_case: [' + str(Q1) + ', ' + str(Q2) + ']')
print('mechanical_boundary_leaves_equilibrium_extent_unchanged: ' + str(bool(same)))

document.magnetic_model: Each formula unit has one tetrahedral Asite and two labelled octahedral Bsites. Both Bmoments are parallel and antiparallel to A;all site moments are collinear. Measured net moment magnitude per formula unit is4mu_B. Use the supplied ionic moment model exactly;no orbital,covalent or noncollinear corrections are included.
document.spectral_model: A separate ideal spectral measurement resolves Fe(II)and Fe(III)but not individual sites. Integrated line area equals number of ions times a known per-ion response factor. Fe(II)factor is2and Fe(III)factor1. The observed normalized areas are[0.5,0.5]in[Fe(II),Fe(III)]order. Equal areas are not stipulated equal ion counts.
document.target: Use actual formula stoichiometry,neutrality and the moment observation to retain every allowed site-valence assignment. Report Fe(II)/Fe(III)counts per formula unit,all retained vectors in source site order,and whether ALL labelled sites have identified valences. Check whether the spectral areas agree with those counts after response correction;do not infer counts directly from equal raw areas.
document.scope: Formal-valence and ionic-moment consistency only. The model does not prove a real magnetite charge-order structure or experimentally validate integer local valence.

site_elements = ['Fe', 'Fe', 'Fe']
allowed = [2, 3]
n_Fe = 3
n_O = 4
oxygen_valence = -2
mu = {2: 4.0, 3: 5.0}
target_moment = 4.0

target_charge = -oxygen_valence * n_O
print('site_order_used', site_order)
print('site_elements_used', site_elements)
print('allowed_valences_used', allowed)
print('n_Fe_n_O_oxygen_valence', n_Fe, n_O, oxygen_valence)
print('moment_map_used', mu)
print('net_moment_target_muB', target_moment)
print('charge_target_from_neutrality', target_charge)

vectors = [[]]
for i in range(len(site_order)):
    grown = []
    for v in vectors:
        for val in allowed:
            grown = grown + [v + [val]]
    vectors = grown
print('enumerated_vector_count', len(vectors))

neutral = []
for c in vectors:
    if len(c) == n_Fe and sum(c) == target_charge:
        neutral = neutral + [c]
print('neutral_vector_count', len(neutral))
print('neutral_vectors', neutral)

lo = min(allowed)
hi = max(allowed)
n_hi = (target_charge - lo * n_Fe) / (hi - lo)
n_lo = n_Fe - n_hi
print('Fe_II_and_Fe_III_counts_per_formula_unit', [n_lo, n_hi])

retained = []
for c in neutral:
    mA = mu[c[0]]
    mB = 0.0
    for k in range(1, len(c)):
        mB = mB + mu[c[k]]
    net = abs(mA - mB)
    print('candidate', c, 'A_moment_muB', mA, 'B_moment_sum_muB', mB, 'net_moment_muB', net)
    if abs(net - target_moment) < 1e-9:
        retained = retained + [c]
print('retained_count', len(retained))
print('retained_site_valence_assignments', retained)
print('retained_in_site_order', site_order, retained)

all_id = True
if len(retained) > 0:
    for j in range(len(site_order)):
        for r in retained:
            if r[j] != retained[0][j]:
                all_id = False
print('all_labelled_site_valences_identified', all_id)

establish statistical significance, or correct sampling/measurement bias.

Apply one declared arithmetic operation to a numeric vector or matrix.

Args:
    operation: add/subtract/multiply/divide use values as the left operand.
        sqrt/log/exp/reciprocal/abs are unary. log is the natural logarithm.
    values: A nonempty 1D vector or nonempty rectangular 2D matrix, with at
        most 10000 total finite real entries in scientific row/column order.
        Ragged, mixed vector/matrix, empty rows and deeper nesting fail.
        Booleans/null/strings are rejected. Arithmetic is ordinary float64,
        not arbitrary-precision integer or symbolic arithmetic.
    other: For binary operations, either one finite numeric scalar broadcast
        to every row, or a finite vector of EXACTLY the same length. A
        one-element list is not broadcast. For a 2D matrix, other may be
        a scalar or an exactly matching rectangular 2D matrix; 1D vectors,
        single-row/column broadcasting and all implicit axis expansion fail. Unary operations require null.

Returns:
    dict with operation, values (same ordered shape, all finite floats),
    length (outer length), shape, element_count, operand_mode
    (unary/scalar_broadcast/aligned_vector/aligned_matrix), and scope.
    No file, network, code generation, expression evaluation, model fitting
    or unit inference occurs. Callers must establish compatible quantities,
    record alignment and meaningful transformations from scientific context.

Raises:

        root, nonpositive logarithm, overflow/nonfinite result, or a nonzero
        multiply/divide/exp result that underflows to zero. Failing element
        indices are zero-based row-major indices.
        Entire calls fail; invalid rows are not dropped, clipped or imputed.

Args:

MatchedPeriodicDisplacements.name: MatchedPeriodicDisplacements
MatchedPeriodicDisplacements.description:
Return minimum-image displacements for fixed same-index crystal sites.

CIF fractional positions are preserved without rational-coordinate snapping.

Both explicitly uploaded ordered structures must contain the same species
sequence, 1..256 sites and a common cell (absolute entry tolerance 1e-8 A).
No atom permutation, rigid alignment, strain removal or trajectory unwrapping
is performed. Cell rows are lattice vectors. For atom i displacement is
mobile_cart[i] + image_shift[i] @ reference_cell - reference_cart[i].
Fractional source coordinates must be finite with abs<=1e6. Volume>=1e-8 A^3
and perpendicular cell heights>=1e-5 A are required. Exact reciprocal-height
bounds enumerate at most 1e6 total image candidates; exceeding this rejects
the entire call before enumeration. No [-1,1] assumption is made for skew
cells. Images within 1e-8 A of the minimum are treated as tied: the
lexicographically smallest image is returned, with tie_count and unique flag.
A half-cell displacement therefore need not have a unique direction.
Source SHA256 identifies actual input bytes. This geometric primitive does
not infer diffusion, atomic identity correspondence, or a physical pathway.

Filter,project and order public/file-artifact records without code execution.

records_file is uploaded or an explicit current-task artifact JSON record
list,or an object with data;0..60000 rows,25 MiB maximum. Every record must have
a unique nonempty string id_field. No identifier conversion/deduplication.

predicates is null or up to32 AND-connected objects with field,op,value.
Operators:eq,ne,lt,le,gt,ge,in,not_in,is_null,is_not_null,exists,missing.
eq/ne/in/not_in compare JSON scalar types exactly except numeric1==1.0;
bool is distinct from number. in/not_in value is1..1000 scalars. Other binary
operators take a scalar value;numeric operators require finite numbers.
Unary operators must omit value. Null numeric comparisons return false;
missing predicate fields raise except for explicit exists/missing tests.
Nested field paths,regex,arbitrary expressions and OR are not supported.

fields is null for all fields or up to 256 unique top-level field names;ID
always retained. Every selected requested field must exist;null is retained.
order_by is null or up to 8 objects:{field,direction:'ascending'|'descending',
nulls:'first'|'last'}. Direction defaults ascending,nulls last. Non-null sort
values per key must be one comparable scalar family(number,string,bool).
Missing sort fields and mixed scalar families raise. Ties retain source
order. limit is null or0..60000,applied after filtering and sorting;full
matching count is always returned independently from output count.

Full output records and original non-data metadata are written atomically
under the explicit task-local artifact root,with source/result SHA256 and
exact query parameters. preview_limit0..100 returns complete projected rows
up to20000 characters,without altering artifact selection. Empty results are
valid. No threshold,hypothesis family,background,scientific unit or method
is inferred,and no sampling or missing-value imputation occurs.

ElementwiseNumericOperations.output_description:
Apply one declared arithmetic operation to a numeric vector or matrix.

Args:
    operation: add/subtract/multiply/divide use values as the left operand.
        sqrt/log/exp/reciprocal/abs are unary. log is the natural logarithm.
    values: A nonempty 1D vector or nonempty rectangular 2D matrix, with at
        most 10000 total finite real entries in scientific row/column order.
        Ragged, mixed vector/matrix, empty rows and deeper nesting fail.
        Booleans/null/strings are rejected. Arithmetic is ordinary float64,
        not arbitrary-precision integer or symbolic arithmetic.
    other: For binary operations, either one finite numeric scalar broadcast
        to every row, or a finite vector of EXACTLY the same length. A
        one-element list is not broadcast. For a 2D matrix, other may be
        a scalar or an exactly matching rectangular 2D matrix; 1D vectors,
        single-row/column broadcasting and all implicit axis expansion fail. Unary operations require null.

Returns:
    dict with operation, values (same ordered shape, all finite floats),
    length (outer length), shape, element_count, operand_mode
    (unary/scalar_broadcast/aligned_vector/aligned_matrix), and scope.
    No file, network, code generation, expression evaluation, model fitting
    or unit inference occurs. Callers must establish compatible quantities,
    record alignment and meaningful transformations from scientific context.

Raises:
    ValueError: Invalid length/type/operation, zero division, negative square
        root, nonpositive logarithm, overflow/nonfinite result, or a nonzero
        multiply/divide/exp result that underflows to zero. Failing element
        indices are zero-based row-major indices.

CalculateDensity.name: CalculateDensity
CalculateDensity.description:
Calculate static periodic-cell mass density with complete source provenance.

Args:
    file_name: Existing periodic structure file supported by pymatgen,
        such as CIF or POSCAR; absolute path or task attachment name.
        The supplied cell must have finite positive volume and mass.

Returns:
    density_g_per_cm3, mass_u and volume_angstrom_cubed as unrounded finite
    numbers; sites, formula, source_file, source_sha256 and method. Density
    uses occupancy-weighted cell mass and the supplied cell volume. It is
    not a measured bulk/powder density, porosity estimate or relaxed state.

Raises:
    FileNotFoundError: Missing source file.
    ValueError: Unreadable structure, nonpositive/nonfinite volume or mass,
        or a source file that changes while it is being read. No error is
        returned as a successful density observation.

NumericRangeMask.output_description:
Return an ordered 0/1 indicator for a declared finite numeric range.

Accept a nonempty finite 1D vector or rectangular 2D matrix, with at most
10000 total cells. Boolean/null cells, ragged or higher-dimensional input
are rejected. Bounds are finite numbers or null; null is unbounded, never
a missing-cell replacement. Inclusive flags must be actual booleans.
A reversed range is an error. Equal endpoints with either endpoint open
produce a valid all-zero mask. Two null bounds produce an all-one mask.
Output numeric 0/1 preserves every input position and shape. No rows are

FitParametricCurve.output_description:
Fit one declared fixed curve family using bounded local least squares.

Families/formula/parameter order are public REGISTRY. There are2 or3 fitted
parameters, at most1000 observations, and observations must exceed parameter
count. Duplicate x observations are allowed; at least2 distinct x are needed.
Optional sigma are positive observation standard deviations, not weights;
residuals are divided by sigma. No weights are estimated. Absolute_sigma
affects approximate covariance scaling only. Bounds may narrow but never
widen family domains; per-entry null means the family's default bound.
Linear, soft_l1 or huber loss uses fixed f_scale1 in sigma-scaled units.
Return local optimizer diagnostics even when not converged; success only
means numeric termination, never global optimum or scientific applicability.
Approximate local covariance is supplied only for converged, full-column-rank,
interior linear-loss fits with residual df>0. It assumes independent errors,
a locally adequate model and supplied sigma conventions. Active bounds,
robust losses, nonconvergence or deficient rank return null covariance/SE.
No confidence interval, extrapolation validity or model-selection claim.

limitations:
Fit one declared fixed curve family using bounded local least squares.

Families/formula/parameter order are public REGISTRY. There are2 or3 fitted
parameters, at most1000 observations, and observations must exceed parameter
count. Duplicate x observations are allowed; at least2 distinct x are needed.
Optional sigma are positive observation standard deviations, not weights;

affects approximate covariance scaling only. Bounds may narrow but never
widen family domains; per-entry null means the family's default bound.

means numeric termination, never global optimum or scientific applicability.

a locally adequate model and supplied sigma conventions. Active bounds,
robust losses, nonconvergence or deficient rank return null covariance/SE.

V2 = np.array([13.6, 14.3, 15.0, 15.7, 16.4])
E2 = np.array([-4.913299926642171, -4.940824981660543, -4.95, -4.940824981660543, -4.913299926642171])
CONV = 160.2176634
p_lo = 0.0
p_hi = 8.0 / CONV
c1 = np.polyfit(V1, E1, 2)
c2 = np.polyfit(V2, E2, 2)
a1, b1, d1 = float(c1[0]), float(c1[1]), float(c1[2])
a2, b2, d2 = float(c2[0]), float(c2[1]), float(c2[2])
res1 = float(np.max(np.abs(np.polyval(c1, V1) - E1)))
res2 = float(np.max(np.abs(np.polyval(c2, V2) - E2)))
vmin1, vmax1 = float(np.min(V1)), float(np.max(V1))
vmin2, vmax2 = float(np.min(V2)), float(np.max(V2))
A = a1 - a2
B = 2.0 * (a1 * b2 - a2 * b1)
C = a1 * b2 * b2 - a2 * b1 * b1 + 4.0 * a1 * a2 * (d1 - d2)
sq = np.sqrt(B * B - 4.0 * A * C)
r1 = (-B + sq) / (2.0 * A)
r2 = (-B - sq) / (2.0 * A)
eps = 1e-9
cands = []
for r in (r1, r2):
    rr = float(r)
    if p_lo <= rr <= p_hi:

parameters.name: counts_file
parameters.description: Uploaded/public UTF-8 TSV, gene rows; gene_id_column is the identity field and every other column is raw nonnegative integer sample counts. All rows are fitted, no gene preselection. <=50MiB,60000genes64samples2millioncells.

parameters.name: metadata_file
parameters.description: Uploaded/public UTF-8 CSV, one unique sample per row. Its complete sample identities must match count columns exactly before optional sample subsetting. <=50MiB.

parameters.name: design_factors
parameters.description: 1..6 unique categorical metadata columns for additive intercept-plus-factor effects. Each factor must vary, categorical coding must be full rank with >=2 residual degrees of freedom. No continuous covariates/interactions/random effects. Additive factor order has no scientific meaning and is lexically canonicalized before coding/fitting/cache identity.

parameters.name: contrast
parameters.description: Exactly [factor,tested_level,reference_level]; the signed log2 fold change is tested/reference. Factor must be in design and each contrasted level must have >=2 fitted samples.

parameters.name: sample_id_column
parameters.description: Metadata column containing exact sample identities, default sample_id. Cannot be a design factor.

inputs.notes: Explicit nonnegative integer gene-by-sample count source.

1..6 unique categorical metadata columns for additive intercept-plus-factor effects. Each factor must vary, categorical coding must be full rank with >=2 residual degrees of freedom. No continuous covariates/interactions/random effects. Additive factor order has no scientific meaning and is lexically canonicalized before coding/fitting/cache identity.
Exactly [factor,tested_level,reference_level]; the signed log2 fold change is tested/reference. Factor must be in design and each contrasted level must have >=2 fitted samples.
Metadata column containing exact sample identities, default sample_id. Cannot be a design factor.
Count TSV column containing unique nonempty gene identities, default gene_id; all other columns are sample counts.

Requested PyDESeq2 dispersion trend parametric(default) or mean. Actual fallback and warnings are returned, never hidden.
Apply library Cook distance p-value filtering, default true. Count replacement remains false and independent filtering remains false regardless.
Default true. Reuse numerical model results keyed by input bytes, parameters, package versions and implementation SHA; still write a fresh task-local result artifact. No gold-answer cache.

returns.description: SHA256 of the complete output's unique string IDs, sorted by Python Unicode string order, serialized as UTF-8 JSON with ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',',':'), and no trailing newline. Independent of row order, projection and predicate syntax; includes the effect of limit. Empty output hashes the bytes [] . This is an identity-set fingerprint, not a hash of scientific field values or proof of eligibility.

returns.name: limit_applied
returns.description: True exactly when limit removes matching rows.

returns.name: record_id_field
returns.description: Identity field retained in every projected output record.

returns.name: preview_records
returns.description: Complete projected records, possibly empty when preview is disabled or a record exceeds its budget. Dynamic field values and types remain those of the input; no units or missing values are inferred.

returns.name: preview_record_count
returns.description: Number of complete records actually included in preview_records.

returns.name: preview_truncated
returns.description: True when the preview omits any full artifact record.

returns.name: query
returns.description: Exact normalized query parameters: predicates, fields, order_by and limit. Empty condition/sort lists and null projection/limit are retained.

returns.name: scope
returns.description: Boundary of the explicit record transformation; no scientific decision is inferred.

returns.name: verified_provenance
returns.description: Readable sibling provenance accepted only when its raw_sha256 matches the input bytes.

limitations:
Filter,project and order public/file-artifact records without code execution.

records_file is uploaded or an explicit current-task artifact JSON record
list,or an object with data;0..60000 rows,25 MiB maximum. Every record must have
a unique nonempty string id_field. No identifier conversion/deduplication.

predicates is null or up to32 AND-connected objects with field,op,value.
Operators:eq,ne,lt,le,gt,ge,in,not_in,is_null,is_not_null,exists,missing.
eq/ne/in/not_in compare JSON scalar types exactly except numeric1==1.0;
bool is distinct from number. in/not_in value is1..1000 scalars. Other binary
operators take a scalar value;numeric operators require finite numbers.
Unary operators must omit value. Null numeric comparisons return false;
missing predicate fields raise except for explicit exists/missing tests.
Nested field paths,regex,arbitrary expressions and OR are not supported.

fields is null for all fields or up to 256 unique top-level field names;ID
always retained. Every selected requested field must exist;null is retained.
order_by is null or up to 8 objects:{field,direction:'ascending'|'descending',
nulls:'first'|'last'}. Direction defaults ascending,nulls last. Non-null sort
values per key must be one comparable scalar family(number,string,bool).
Missing sort fields and mixed scalar families raise. Ties retain source
order. limit is null or0..60000,applied after filtering and sorting;full
matching count is always returned independently from output count.

Full output records and original non-data metadata are written atomically
under the explicit task-local artifact root,with source/result SHA256 and
exact query parameters. preview_limit0..100 returns complete projected rows
up to20000 characters,without altering artifact selection. Empty results are
valid. No threshold,hypothesis family,background,scientific unit or method
is inferred,and no sampling or missing-value imputation occurs.

Only public uploads and explicit current-task artifacts are readable. No eval, network access, generated code, LLM or GPU is used. Complete artifacts are limited to 50 MiB; full selection/family counts and source/result hashes are reported.

inputs.notes: Uploaded or current-task artifact JSON file. Accepts a record list, or an object with a data list, containing 0–60,000 rows and at most 25 MiB. Private files and shared artifact directories are not readable. Compatibility is conditional on this tool contract, units, identities and scientific assumptions.

outputs.notes: Path to the complete atomic JSON artifact under the explicit task root. Data and original non-data metadata remain at the top level. Previous operation metadata is preserved under operation_metadata.parent_operation.
Complete projected records, possibly empty when preview is disabled or a record exceeds its budget. Dynamic field values and types remain those of the input; no units or missing values are inferred.

dataflow.interpretation: Candidate data representations only. Matching concepts never imply automatic unit conversion, row alignment, scientific validity or successful execution.

failure_feedback.invalid_input: status=error, error_type=InvalidInput; inspect the argument error and query DescribeTools for the contract.
failure_feedback.invalid_output: status=error, error_type=InvalidOutput; no contract-invalid or nonfinite result is accepted as scientific evidence.
failure_feedback.missing_resource: status=blocked, error_type=MissingResource or MissingEnvironment; configure the declared dependency.
failure_feedback.external_source: Remote failures, missing scientific data and pending jobs are reported explicitly; no fallback value is invented.
failure_feedback.retired_name: status=error, error_type=RetiredTool with active replacement names and explicit migration guidance; incompatible signatures are never silently aliased.

data.representative_policy: Use all ten submitted models and the same complete 76 matching C-alpha residues. Pairwise dissimilarity is minimum root-mean-square corresponding-point distance after an independent proper rigid rotation and translation for each pair, with equal residue weights. Reflection, scale fitting and residue re-matching are excluded. Select every model attaining the lowest mean RMSD to the other nine models, tied within 1e-8 angstrom. Report that minimum mean, the largest pairwise RMSD from any selected representative to any ensemble member, and the diameter over all model pairs. Keep model identity attached to each point set; consistent common residue and model ordering changes are allowed.
data.research_scope: Choose an observed submitted conformer as a descriptive geometric representative. The ten deposited low-energy calculated models are not ten independent experimental replicates or a sampled equilibrium distribution. These RMSDs do not estimate model accuracy, experimental precision, thermal fluctuations, dynamic pathways or confidence intervals; no model/sequence is designed or modified.

ParseNewickTreeDistances.name: ParseNewickTreeDistances
ParseNewickTreeDistances.description: Parse a bounded named-tip Newick tree and compute named-tip patristic distances from strictly positive finite branch lengths on every nonroot node, rejecting missing ordinary lengths; absent/zero root stem only. These are distances on a supplied tree, not sequence phylogeny inference or temporal divergence estimates.

parameters.name: newick_text
parameters.description: Exactly one semicolon-terminated explicitly parenthesized Newick tree. Restricted ASCII labels [A-Za-z0-9_.-]+ only; no quoted labels, comments or inferred confidence. Every nonroot edge must have an explicit strictly positive finite representable float64 length; root stem absent or mathematically zero (nonzero lexical underflow is rejected). Internal nodes have at least2children; polytomies allowed. Unique exact labelled tips2..100, totalnodes<=200, depth<=100. Whitespace is accepted only between grammar tokens, not inside labels or numeric literals. No filesystem or network access.

data.analysis_policy: The complete family is trt1 versus ctrl and trt2 versus ctrl, with 10 original plants in each group. For each comparison use a two-sided unequal-variance Welch mean test, with the conventional Welch-Satterthwaite reference under stipulated independent-plant and approximately normal within-group working assumptions. Use Bonferroni across both comparisons at family alpha 0.05, allowing dependence from the shared control. A treatment qualifies for greater mean dry weight only when its observed treatment-minus-control difference is positive and its family-adjusted p-value is at most 0.05. The source does not fully specify a dry-weight unit; do not relabel grams. Neither the working assumptions nor a causal or representative population interpretation is established by these data.

Apply one declared arithmetic operation to a numeric vector or matrix.

Args:
    operation: add/subtract/multiply/divide use values as the left operand.
        sqrt/log/exp/reciprocal/abs are unary. log is the natural logarithm.
    values: A nonempty 1D vector or nonempty rectangular 2D matrix, with at
        most 10000 total finite real entries in scientific row/column order.
        Ragged, mixed vector/matrix, empty rows and deeper nesting fail.
        Booleans/null/strings are rejected. Arithmetic is ordinary float64,
        not arbitrary-precision integer or symbolic arithmetic.
    other: For binary operations, either one finite numeric scalar broadcast
        to every row, or a finite vector of EXACTLY the same length. A
        one-element list is not broadcast. For a 2D matrix, other may be
        a scalar or an exactly matching rectangular 2D matrix; 1D vectors,
        single-row/column broadcasting and all implicit axis expansion fail. Unary operations require null.

Returns:
    dict with operation, values (same ordered shape, all finite floats),
    length (outer length), shape, element_count, operand_mode
    (unary/scalar_broadcast/aligned_vector/aligned_matrix), and scope.
    No file, network, code generation, expression evaluation, model fitting
    or unit inference occurs. Callers must establish compatible quantities,
    record alignment and meaningful transformations from scientific context.

Raises:
    ValueError: Invalid length/type/operation, zero division, negative square
        root, nonpositive logarithm, overflow/nonfinite result, or a nonzero
        multiply/divide/exp result that underflows to zero. Failing element
        indices are zero-based row-major indices.
        Entire calls fail; invalid rows are not dropped, clipped or imputed.

SolveLinearProgram.description: Optimize an explicit continuous linear objective subject to supplied equalities, inequalities and bounds. Return verified primal/dual witnesses in original units or an explicit infeasible/unbounded/numerical failure.
SolveLinearProgram.call_signature: SolveLinearProgram(objective: list, bounds: list, inequality_matrix: list | None=None, inequality_rhs: list | None=None, equality_matrix: list | None=None, equality_rhs: list | None=None, direction: str='min') -> dict

parameters.name: objective
parameters.description: Ordered1..500 finite real coefficients c of the REQUESTED objective c dot x. Internally divide by max(abs(c)) or1 for an all-zero objective. Nonzero normalized coefficients require abs>=1e-8; unsupported dynamic ranges fail with a rescaling hint. Boolean/string/null/nonfinite cells fail. Caller owns scientific variable definitions, units and order.

parameters.name: bounds
parameters.description: Exactly one explicit[lower,upper]pair per variable; finite endpoints have abs<=1e12. null means an unbounded endpoint, never zero. No implicit nonnegativity or broadcasting; fixed variables are allowed but lower cannot exceed upper.

parameters.name: inequality_matrix
parameters.description: Rows of A_ub in A_ub*x<=b_ub, width exactly objective length. Jointly null with RHS or aligned lists;[],[]means no rows. Each row and RHS is internally divided by max(abs(row)),or abs(RHS),or1 for a zero row. Nonzero normalized coefficients require abs>=1e-8. data.analysis_policy: Here sex_identified means recorded code M or F and infant_coded means recorded code I; these are archive labels, not independently verified ages or maturity cutoffs. Fit one ordinary least-squares ring-count calibration with intercept using only training_records and the three declared geometric feature columns. Freeze it for both test cohorts; do not refit or tune separately by source-code cohort. Retain exact row identities when comparing truth/prediction. RMSE is in rings; signed mean prediction error means prediction minus observed rings. Report all largest-RMSE ties within 1e-9. Individual infant ages or clinical effects are outside scope.
data.panel_derivation: From all positive-height raw records, preserve original within-stratum order; default_rng(104) first permutes all M/F rows then all I rows. First240 M/F permutation entries train, next120 M/F entries test, first120 I permutation entries test. Original source_row_id is one-based file row. This is a declared archived comparison, not evidence of external representativeness.

QueryScientificRecordsFile.call_signature: QueryScientificRecordsFile(records_file: str, id_field: str, predicates: list | None=None, fields: list | None=None, order_by: list | None=None, limit: int | None=None, preview_limit: int=20) -> dict

parameters.name: records_file
parameters.description: Uploaded or current-task artifact JSON file. Accepts a record list, or an object with a data list, containing 0–60,000 rows and at most 25 MiB. Private files and shared artifact directories are not readable.

parameters.name: id_field
parameters.description: Literal source identity key; every source ID must be a unique nonempty string or integer, with no implicit type conversion.

parameters.name: predicates
parameters.description: Null or up to 32 AND conditions. Each has field and op; binary operators require value and unary operators omit it. Missing predicate fields raise except for exists/missing. Null numeric comparisons return false. Validation precedes filtering, so condition order cannot hide malformed data.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Null keeps all fields. Otherwise provide up to 256 distinct top-level field names. The identity field is always retained. Missing requested fields in selected rows raise; explicit null values remain null.

parameters.name: order_by
parameters.description: Null or up to 8 distinct sort keys. Each key has field, optional direction (ascending/descending), and optional nulls (first/last). Missing fields or mixed non-null scalar families raise. Equal keys retain source order.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Null retains all matches. An integer from 0 to 60,000 limits rows after filtering and sorting. Full matching count and artifact output count are reported separately.

parameters.name: preview_limit
parameters.description: Return 0–100 complete preview rows within a 20,000-character budget. This does not change the full artifact. If a row exceeds the preview budget, omit it and report truncation; never return malformed partial JSON.

parameters.description: Null retains all matches. An integer from 0 to 60,000 limits rows after filtering and sorting. Full matching count and artifact output count are reported separately.

Rowpositions0:60are development,60:90selection validation,90:120untouched assessment. SolveLinearProgram.description: Optimize an explicit continuous linear objective subject to supplied equalities, inequalities and bounds. Return verified primal/dual witnesses in original units or an explicit infeasible/unbounded/numerical failure.
SolveLinearProgram.call_signature: SolveLinearProgram(objective: list, bounds: list, inequality_matrix: list | None=None, inequality_rhs: list | None=None, equality_matrix: list | None=None, equality_rhs: list | None=None, direction: str='min') -> dict

parameters.name: objective
parameters.description: Ordered1..500 finite real coefficients c of the REQUESTED objective c dot x. Internally divide by max(abs(c)) or1 for an all-zero objective. Nonzero normalized coefficients require abs>=1e-8; unsupported dynamic ranges fail with a rescaling hint. Boolean/string/null/nonfinite cells fail. Caller owns scientific variable definitions, units and order.

parameters.name: bounds
parameters.description: Exactly one explicit[lower,upper]pair per variable; finite endpoints have abs<=1e12. null means an unbounded endpoint, never zero. No implicit nonnegativity or broadcasting; fixed variables are allowed but lower cannot exceed upper.

parameters.name: inequality_matrix
parameters.description: Rows of A_ub in A_ub*x<=b_ub, width exactly objective length. Jointly null with RHS or aligned lists;[],[]means no rows. Each row and RHS is internally divided by max(abs(row)),or abs(RHS),or1 for a zero row. Nonzero normalized coefficients require abs>=1e-8. Combined equality/inequality limits:2000rows and100000coefficients.

parameters.name: inequality_rhs
parameters.description: Finite inequality RHS values aligned to source rows. After positive row scaling, nonzero RHS magnitude must be in1e-8..1e12; unsupported ranges fail explicitly. Transform BOTH sides to represent greater-than constraints. Marginals are reversed to original RHS units.

parameters.name: equality_matrix
parameters.description: Rows of A_eq in A_eq*x=b_eq, width exactly objective length; jointly null with RHS or aligned lists. Positive numerical row scaling and normalized coefficient guards are the same as for inequalities. No scientific normalization constraint, conservation law or intercept is inserted.

parameters.name: equality_rhs
parameters.description: Finite equality RHS values in the same row order. After positive row scaling, nonzero RHS magnitude must be in1e-8..1e12. Caller establishes the continuous model; returned marginals use original RHS units.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: min minimizes the requested objective, max maximizes it. Objective value and all returned marginals use this requested direction, including sign reversal from the internal minimization for max.

objective.description: Ordered1..500 finite real coefficients c of the REQUESTED objective c dot x. Internally divide by max(abs(c)) or1 for an all-zero objective. Nonzero normalized coefficients require abs>=1e-8; unsupported dynamic ranges fail with a rescaling hint. Boolean/string/null/nonfinite cells fail. Caller owns scientific variable definitions, units and order.

Positive numerical row scaling and normalized coefficient guards are the same as for inequalities. No scientific normalization constraint, conservation law or intercept is inserted.

direction.description: min minimizes the requested objective, max maximizes it. Objective value and all returned marginals use this requested direction, including sign reversal from the internal minimization for max.

SolveLinearProgram.output_description: Model/solver status; optimal finite solution and requested original objective with source-ordered KKT diagnostics, or null numeric optimum for nonoptimal statuses. Positive internal scales and original-unit marginals are explicit. validation_error explains discarded solver-optimal results; SciPy version and numerical limits retained.

status.description: Scientific MODEL/solver outcome, distinct from the outer tool execution status. Only optimal supplies a numerically verified optimum; infeasible/unbounded are floating solver classifications, not exact infeasibility certificates.

solution.description: Optimal decision variables in objective/bounds order. Null for every nonoptimal status; no partial iterate is presented as a solution.

objective_value.description: c dot solution for the requested min/max objective, null for nonoptimal outcomes.

inequality_slack.description: b_ub-A_ub*x in source constraint order; a negative value is a primal violation.

equality_residual.description: b_eq-A_eq*x in source equality order, nominally zero.

lower_bound_slack.description: x-lower in variable order; null for an unbounded lower endpoint.

upper_bound_slack.description: upper-x in variable order; null for an unbounded upper endpoint.

inequality_marginals.description: Derivative of REQUESTED optimum with respect to inequality RHS. Nonpositive for min, nonnegative for max, using SciPy marginal convention.

equality_marginals.description: Derivative of REQUESTED optimum with respect to equality RHS; either sign is possible.

lower_bound_marginals.description: Derivative of REQUESTED optimum with respect to lower endpoints; nonnegative for min and nonpositive for max. Unbounded endpoints have numerically zero marginal.

upper_bound_marginals.description: Derivative of REQUESTED optimum with respect to upper endpoints; nonpositive for min and nonnegative for max.

dual_objective.description: RHS dot marginals plus finite-bound endpoints dot their marginals, in requested-objective units. Null endpoints contribute no term.

scaled_primal_violation.description: Maximum scaled inequality/equality/bound feasibility violation, also checking zero marginals for nonexistent endpoints.

dual_sign_violation.description: Maximum sign violation for inequality and finite-bound marginals after accounting for min/max direction.

scaled_complementarity_violation.description: Maximum absolute slack-times-marginal, scaled by1+absolute requested objective.

scaled_duality_gap.description: Absolute requested primal-minus-dual objective divided by1+absolute primal+absolute dual.

validation_tolerance.description: Numerical verification tolerance; not an exact rational certificate or scientific uncertainty interval.

diagnostics.description: Primal/dual witnesses, slacks and scaled numerical verification when optimal; null otherwise. Degenerate optima can have different valid primal and dual witnesses.

validation_error.description: Explains discarded optimum when SciPy reports optimal but finite-value/KKT verification fails. Null when verification did not fail.

variable_count.description: Number of continuous variables; integrality is not supported or implied.

equality_count.description: Number of supplied equality rows, including redundancies.

solver_status_code.description: Actual SciPy status code;0optimal,1limit,2infeasible,3unbounded,other solver failure. Validation can still change the exposed status to numerical_failure.

solver_message.description: Actual SciPy/HiGHS explanation. Consult status and validation_error before using scientific outputs.

scipy_version.description: Actual SciPy package version used in the worker.

numerical_protocol.description: Solver method, thread/iteration/time settings, feasibility tolerances and finite numerical optimality checks.

QueryScientificRecordsFile.name: QueryScientificRecordsFile
QueryScientificRecordsFile.description: Filter, project and stably order a public JSON record file with explicit predicates and a typed string/integer identity field. Preserve source provenance and write complete output plus a bounded preview.
QueryScientificRecordsFile.call_signature: QueryScientificRecordsFile(records_file: str, id_field: str, predicates: list | None=None, fields: list | None=None, order_by: list | None=None, limit: int | None=None, preview_limit: int=20) -> dict

parameters.name: records_file
parameters.description: Uploaded or current-task artifact JSON file. Accepts a record list, or an object with a data list, containing 0–60,000 rows and at most 25 MiB. Private files and shared artifact directories are not readable.

parameters.name: id_field
parameters.description: Literal source identity key; every source ID must be a unique nonempty string or integer, with no implicit type conversion.

parameters.name: predicates
parameters.description: Null or up to 32 AND conditions. Each has field and op; binary operators require value and unary operators omit it. Missing predicate fields raise except for exists/missing. Null numeric comparisons return false. Validation precedes filtering, so condition order cannot hide malformed data.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Null keeps all fields. Otherwise provide up to 256 distinct top-level field names. The identity field is always retained. Missing requested fields in selected rows raise; explicit null values remain null.

parameters.name: order_by
parameters.description: Null or up to 8 distinct sort keys. Each key has field, optional direction (ascending/descending), and optional nulls (first/last). Missing fields or mixed non-null scalar families raise. Equal keys retain source order.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Null retains all matches. An integer from 0 to 60,000 limits rows after filtering and sorting. Full matching count and artifact output count are reported separately.

parameters.name: preview_limit
parameters.description: Return 0–100 complete preview rows within a 20,000-character budget. This does not change the full artifact. If a row exceeds the preview budget, omit it and report truncation; never return malformed partial JSON.

PRESS residual/(1-h_ii) is an equivalent computation when its denominator is nonzero. Ties within1e-10 use smaller degree.

document.answer_contract_note: The nullable MSE fields are required because full-rank eligibility must be checked.

parameters.name: records_file
parameters.description: Uploaded or current-task artifact JSON file. Accepts a record list, or an object with a data list, containing 0–60,000 rows and at most 25 MiB. Private files and shared artifact directories are not readable.

parameters.name: id_field
parameters.description: Literal source identity key; every source ID must be a unique nonempty string or integer, with no implicit type conversion.

parameters.name: predicates
parameters.description: Null or up to 32 AND conditions. Each has field and op; binary operators require value and unary operators omit it. Missing predicate fields raise except for exists/missing. parameters.description: Null keeps all fields. Otherwise provide up to 256 distinct top-level field names. The identity field is always retained. Missing requested fields in selected rows raise; explicit null values remain null.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Null retains all matches. An integer from 0 to 60,000 limits rows after filtering and sorting. Full matching count and artifact output count are reported separately.

parameters.name: preview_limit
parameters.description: Return 0–100 complete preview rows within a 20,000-character budget. This does not change the full artifact. If a row exceeds the preview budget, omit it and report truncation; never return malformed partial JSON.

document.model: Each report estimates the SAME unknown fixed voltage theta: y_i=theta+loading_i*z+epsilon_i. z and all epsilon_i have zero mean, are mutually independent, and have the stated known variances. Report values are one realized panel. There are no unknown variance components to estimate.
document.pooling_policy: Among ALL linear unbiased estimates sum_i w_i*y_i with sum_i w_i=1, minimize the true variance. Signed weights are allowed: they are coefficients of estimators, not physical mixture fractions. Preserve source report order for the returned weights.
document.comparison_policy: The proposed independence report uses inverse-MARGINAL-variance weights (including each shared-offset contribution on its diagonal) but ignores every off-diagonal covariance. Its reported variance is the reciprocal of the sum of these marginal precisions. Separately compute the ACTUAL variance of that SAME naive-weight estimator under the true joint model. Do not compare the naive reported variance with the optimal estimator variance as if they described one estimator.
